data.exact_reserve_text:
Closed years
There were no issues arising from our closed years being 2007 to 2012 and all of these years combined produced a surplus which contributed both to the calendar year result and the closing 2013 account result.
2013Account
At thirty-six months the account has produced a pure loss and prior year underwriting profit together with a small amount of investment income.Overall the result is a profit of $0.05 million (which equates to GBP 0.03 million) which is 0.1% of a stamp capacity of GBP 30 million.

named_events.event_name: Collapse of the global oil price
named_events.loss_description: The dominant issue during the year, which has affected both our cargo and offshore energy lines, has been the collapse of the global oil price during 2015. For our cargo account the drop in oil prices ... resulted in much lower sums insured coupled with a decline in the number of shipments.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were $40.081m (statement of financial position). The report contains narrative that closed years 2007-2012 "produced a surplus" and that the 2013 account at 36 months showed a prior year underwriting profit, indicating favourable prior-year reserve development. No explicit gross movement in prior years' provisions (insurance liabilities) is reported in the available notes, so a quantitative prior-year development amount could not be determined from the disclosed gross reserve movement. The dominant operational issue in 2015 cited by management was the collapse of global oil prices, which affected Marine (cargo) and Energy exposures but relates to underwriting and exposure rather than to a quantified prior-year reserve strengthening.

The opening gross claims outstanding was taken from the Statement of Financial Position (gross claims outstanding prior-year comparative). A loss-ratio development table is present but gross premiums by underwriting year are not provided, so PYD could not be derived from the loss-ratio triangle. Prior-year narrative indicates favourable run-off for closed years but no gross GBP  figure is disclosed.
